accelerator_only.thermal_observation: S began near 394 FPS, then the health monitor reported about 104 C and reduced the Hailo clock from 400 to 350 and 300 MHz. The earlier 15-second 393.3 FPS result is a short-run peak.

single_route_application.comparison_warning: S and M application timing uses different start markers. Compare accelerator-only HailoRT rows for hardware ranking.

batch_finding: Batch 8 did not improve sustained S throughput. It increased M aggregate HW-only throughput 2.85x while increasing complete-batch latency from 26.89 to 70.10 ms.
precision_limitation: A Hailo-8 HEF has no runtime FP16 alternative. FP16 must be measured on a platform whose accelerator supports it; Hailo rows remain explicitly quantized.
service_restore: All containers stopped for the maintenance window were restarted; mcp_face_rec, mcp_warehouse, missionpack-industrial-gateway, xiaozhi db/redis/web and mcp-endpoint-server were healthy on final verification.
